mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_file ( original_name, store_name, extension, mime_type, file_size, file_path, copyright, copyright_url, uploaded_by_user_no, uploaded_by_admin_no ) VALUES ( #{originalName}, #{storeName}, #{extension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{copyright}, #{copyrightUrl}, #{uploadedByUserNo}, #{uploadedByAdminNo} )
